verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's NIW page describes a flat attorney fee for the I-140 and states that "Adjustment of Status and government filing fees are handled separately." Its own fee terms are also published: RFE responses at no extra cost, a refund for qualifying denials, and pay-in-full with a 10% discount or $500/month over 14 months. Premium processing appears only as a guidance article, not as a separately itemized cost on the pricing page. missing for 10: explicit itemization of premium processing as a separate line on the pricing page, stated dollar amounts for USCIS filing fees alongside the attorney fee, a single all-in cost breakdown, independent corroboration.
